reviewerScope: Independent source-oracle/filiation agent; no src implementation ownership and no native test ownership.
method: Manual static source/native integration review, supported by the separately retained independent public replay. The check count is a review checklist, not an additional executed test suite.

checks.evidence: Strategy imports ObservedCompositionConstraint as ProgramCompositionConstraint; the recurrent caller resolves SupportedLineConstraint.propose.
checks.finding: Both own Repeated and Supported contracts are required; the source fixture records the actual wrapper resolution and MRO.

checks.evidence: Actual memory dispatch resolves higher ReferencePopulation guards/record and CellPlacement propose/packet methods.
checks.finding: Own closure is separate from descendant closure; real observed packet cases retain coupled_pair_epoch_anchor and explicit own projections.

checks.evidence: SharedOccurrenceMemory.recurrentSeriesProjection is one RecurrentSeriesMemory; six historical accessors delegate to it.
checks.finding: No second business-state owner is introduced behind the shared facade.

checks.evidence: SeriesEventMemory routes the five own kinds to applyRecurrentSeriesEvent; SharedOccurrenceMemory overrides that hook.
checks.finding: Own event reduction and historical placement are retained, while top-level shared persistence appends the returned event sequence once.

checks.evidence: Repeated digest precedes Supported digest and then CrossedPrefix, Marked, Program and descendants.
checks.finding: Shared checkpoint structure retains its two initial source slots; no duplicate late Recurrent digest is appended.

checks.evidence: Shared recurrentSeriesDigest delegates historical UTF-16 rejection-key ordering; own retainedDigest uses source Unicode ordering.
checks.finding: Produced trial IDs are ASCII SHA digests and agree; arbitrary opaque Unicode checkpoints retain legacy compatibility without claiming universal source digest identity.

checks.evidence: Field measurement preserves component encounter order, modal-gap first tie, unknown threshold, majority refusal and stable origin order.
checks.finding: Independent source cases cover measured references, even-size centers, palette permutation, unknown limit and repeated endpoints.

checks.evidence: Repeated lineQuestion retains the first matching confirmed anchor and all original support fields; accepted fields and seen trials preserve source semantics.
checks.finding: No later stronger pattern silently replaces the retained experiment; full plans and evidence lists compare against original outputs.

checks.evidence: Supported proposes only after Repeated abstention and its own configuration admission.
checks.finding: Current roles, layout, distinct points/arrivals, blocked extension and persistent order remain dependencies of finite preparation.

checks.evidence: Supported.record observes eligible public point returns even with no own selected plan.
checks.finding: Shared acquisition calls the owner for foreign returns; public parity includes all 21 returns, including seven foreign prefixes.

checks.evidence: Source record reduces trial/scored/refutation/sample before record_packet; shared record calls recurrent packet acquisition after the complete inherited return chain.
checks.finding: Public ordering uses the returned packet suffix, not a final-frame or private-turn surrogate.

checks.evidence: record_packet selects the last sample by source observation reference and overwrites insert_orders by that reference.
checks.finding: The source fixture retains last-sample lookup, source alias across sample epoch, transient visibility, simultaneous arrival and missing persistence.

checks.evidence: RootedQuotaAccess.record returns its own event without invoking older ancestors.
checks.finding: Shared selectedRooted skips recurrent/crossed/program older return acquisition but retains later packet acquisition; integration tests cover the cutoff.

checks.evidence: Repeated and Supported source record call self.after; SharedSeries passes its complete after dispatcher as callback.
checks.finding: Mixed envelopes retain higher guard authority; source component replay rejects extra higher-priority selected plans instead of silently weakening them.

checks.evidence: Shared guard sequence places higher descendant plans before CrossedPrefix, then Recurrent when no OccurrenceRecall plan owns the envelope.
checks.finding: Inside Recurrent, Supported takes precedence over Repeated, matching source own inheritance.

checks.evidence: Source own guards validate bound metadata and full raster but do not authenticate outer actions/bundle/proposal identity.
checks.finding: Pointed common wrapper binds one measured cell in current domain. Complete-envelope/current-public safety remains a separate common obligation, exercised in integration tests.

checks.evidence: Source treats any score inequality, epoch change, WIN or GAME_OVER as boundary; visual scored line without official progress refutes sufficiency.
checks.finding: Native preserves these distinctions, including score decrease, conditional response compatibility and epoch-level Supported refutation.

checks.evidence: Native preserves finite search ordering and exact completed integer scores; production has 250000-node/current-deadline limits.
checks.finding: Unsafe integer or unfinished search returns unknown and block_unrelated_probe with no action, partial ranking or acquired refutation.

checks.evidence: Own restore rebuilds and verifies digest before replacing containers; shared restore uses replacement owner before installation.
checks.finding: Invalid snapshots leave existing owners intact. Historical minimal events are conserved as opaque memory, not upgraded into planning evidence.

checks.evidence: Shared restoration stamp captures Recurrent owner identity, nativeRevision and workingWitness.
checks.finding: Reducer edits, owner replacement, private journal mutation and direct six-container mutations invalidate native reuse; unchanged certified state avoids redundant reduction.

checks.evidence: Original exporter calls unchanged Python; original public replay starts SupportedLineConstraint empty and records every return.
checks.finding: Native public replay reconstructs from its own acquisition; captured proposal memory is comparison data only.

checks.evidence: Each public ablation omits only named own events acquired before the selected decision, or the last prior actual return batch.
checks.finding: All 84 source/native interventions, including 51 action/refusal negatives, remain retained; no game or full-caller counterfactual is claimed.

checks.evidence: Original replay covers 14 selected own proposals, all 21 returns and full packets, 34 events, 22 observations and 36 own restorations.
checks.finding: Native verifier passes 1361 checks with 35 own restorations, matching all 84 ablations; no full inherited caller or timing equivalence is claimed.

qualifications: Native validation accepts canonical retained JSON with string trial/source keys and integer refutation epochs before mutation. Python malformed events may mutate before a later key error; identical partial-failure mutation or exception class is not claimed.
Historical minimal source events and arbitrary opaque checkpoints are retention evidence, not proof that missing fields can be consumed for planning.
Own source Unicode ordering and historical shared UTF-16 opaque rejection ordering are deliberately distinguished; produced ASCII trial IDs agree.
Search deadlines are checked around recursive nodes/root choices; synchronous geometry, window construction and heuristic loops are not claimed to be preempted at every pixel.

Actual Observed adapter parent events are retained separately. No full descendant closure, full-caller ablation, cross-game generalization, final-game victory or timing equivalence follows from this review.
No source/test/fixture changes were made after the declared native freeze; this review creates only a new diagnostic receipt.
